comment: West is one of my favorite teachers here. He is a very wise man and will issue "pearls of wisdom" from time to time. Tests are pretty easy so long as you pay attention in class.
If ever a teacher reminded me of Dumbledore, it was Ellis West.  He is demanding but fair, brilliant but humble.  I cannot recommend Dr. West highly enough.

GREAT GUY!!! funny and entertaining.... extremely smart.. assigns a lot of reading but the tests aren't too difficult if you study and keep up with the reading... you will learn a ton although it is a tough class... poli sci majors def take him!

My favorite teacher, totally turned me onto Constitutional law. Do your work and do it well. If you can memorize things well, you will be fine. Funny guy. Expects a lot, but understands (to an extent) that it is an undergrad class.

Didn't take Prof. West until last semster senior year, and I wish I had taken him earlier b/c I would have kept taking him.  AWESOME prof - better than most of my law school professors now.  He's hysterical in class and will put you on the spot and let you know how wrong you are, but it's all in good fun and to make you learn.
Go to class and do your case briefs- also be prepared to be put on the spot during class discussions! Fair grader, funny guy.

Had him for several classes in college and is definitely the best professor I've ever had.  I'm in law school and I would say that he's still better than all I've had in law school.  Really makes you think logically about stuff and teaches you how to think, rather than just teaching specific info.

A great guy but has a very specific method for grading. I busted my ass memorizing all the court cases and still got a C on the midterm. If you dont know the exact answer ver batim good luck. Although an expert on the first amendment he does not do a very good job relaying which information is impor
He's a really eccentric guy, but he is really helpful, and his grading policies are really fair.
Teaches class like a law school course. Semantics are CRUCIAL -- so is a fundamental understanding of EVERY ruling he discusses. Amiable. Helpful. Knowledgeable.
Best professor I've ever had. Learned a ton from him. Witty and funny. Although he is one of the older professors, he's definitely one of the more exciting ones. Loves to teach and knows a ton.
